description: Account enumeration, then use of another account's credentials, then a new service, in that order within an hour. UBA rules: account_enumeration (Security 4798/4799, summarised per hour), explicit_credentials (Security 4648) and service_installed (System 7045). Windows records no account for 7045 - the Service Control Manager installs the service - so the third step is a machine step: it matches a service installed on this computer, and the hit says that step names no person.
proves: An account looked up accounts and groups, used other credentials, and a service was installed soon after
author: Crow-Eye Team
